p: The significant adverse impact is generally considered when a new shadow would substantially cover a resource for an extended period of time and/or would completely eliminate shadow on that resource and, again, those resources are public open space where a shadow might just make it less usable, less attractive or a feature of a historic resource that depends on sunlight.
